# Linked.Archi — Semantic Assets for Enterprise Architecture

> Ontologies, metamodels, taxonomies, and SHACL shapes for building architectural knowledge graphs.

This site publishes RDF vocabularies (OWL/SHACL/SKOS) with full HTTP content negotiation.
All namespace URIs are dereferenceable — request `text/turtle`, `application/ld+json`,
`application/rdf+xml`, or `application/n-triples` via the Accept header.

## Disclaimer

Linked.Archi is an independent, unofficial project. It is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by,
or produced by The Open Group, OMG, ISO, Spotify, SAP, or any other standards body or vendor.
Trademarked names (ArchiMate, TOGAF, BPMN, UML, Backstage, LeanIX, etc.) are property of
their respective owners. The ontologies here are interpretive formalizations of published
specifications — they represent one possible OWL/SHACL encoding, not an authoritative
normative definition. Always refer to the original specifications for definitive semantics.

## Key Entry Points

- [Ontology Catalog](https://meta.linked.archi/): Interactive index of all semantic assets
- [Documentation](https://meta.linked.archi/docs/): Guides, design decisions, and quick start
- [Full LLM Map](https://meta.linked.archi/llms-full.txt): Complete resource listing with descriptions

Turtle is the canonical serialization. All source files are authored in Turtle.

## Published Ontologies

- [4+1 View Model Taxonomy](https://meta.linked.archi/4plus1): Classification scheme based on Philippe Kruchten's 4+1 View Model (IEEE Software, 1995).
- [4+1 View Model Deliverable Templates](https://meta.linked.archi/4plus1/deliverable-templates): Deliverable templates for the 4+1 Architectural View Model.
- [4+1 View Model Metamodel Manifest](https://meta.linked.archi/4plus1/metamodel): Metamodel manifest for the 4+1 Architectural View Model.
- [4+1 View Model Viewpoints](https://meta.linked.archi/4plus1/viewpoints): Viewpoint definitions for the 4+1 Architectural View Model.
- [Linked.Archi ADMIT Metamodel Definition](https://meta.linked.archi/admit/metamodel): Metamodel manifest for ADMIT.
- [Linked.Archi ADMIT Design Forces Ontology](https://meta.linked.archi/admit/onto): The ADMIT Design Forces Ontology contains the 20 ADMIT architecture design forces as OWL classes extending ad:Force.
- [Linked.Archi ADMIT Framework Taxonomy](https://meta.linked.archi/admit/tax): Classification of architecture concepts from the ADMIT framework.
- [Linked.Archi AI Ethics & Governance Metamodel Definition](https://meta.linked.archi/ai-governance/metamodel): Metamodel manifest for the AI Ethics & Governance extension.
- [Linked.Archi AI Ethics & Governance Extension](https://meta.linked.archi/ai-governance/onto): Extension ontology for AI ethics and governance.
- [Linked.Archi AI Governance Reference Data](https://meta.linked.archi/ai-governance/reference-data): Reference data for AI governance — EU AI Act risk levels, OECD AI Principles, human oversight modes, and assessment statuses.
- [Linked.Archi AI Governance SHACL Shapes](https://meta.linked.archi/ai-governance/shapes): SHACL shapes for validating AI governance models.
- [Linked.Archi AI Governance Taxonomy](https://meta.linked.archi/ai-governance/tax): Classification of AI governance concepts by risk level, principle, lifecycle phase, and assessment type.
- [Linked.Archi Architecture Decisions Metamodel Definition](https://meta.linked.archi/arch-decision/metamodel): Metamodel manifest for the Architecture Decisions extension.
- [Linked.Archi Architecture Decision Ontology](https://meta.linked.archi/arch-decision): Extension ontology for modeling architecture decisions, the issues that trigger them, candidate options, influencing forces (requirements, constraints, trends), the rationale linking forces to chosen 
- [Linked.Archi Architecture Decision SHACL Shapes](https://meta.linked.archi/arch-decision-shapes): SHACL shapes for validating architecture decision records built with the Linked.Archi architecture decision extension.
- [Linked.Archi Architecture Decision Taxonomy](https://meta.linked.archi/arch-decision/tax): Classification of the Architecture Decision element types — the decision record and the forces on it — and of the relationship types that draw its links.
- [Linked.Archi ArchiMate 3.2 Deliverable Templates](https://meta.linked.archi/archimate3/deliverable-templates): Deliverable template definitions for generating architecture documents from ArchiMate 3.2 models: each section answers the concerns it names by asking model questions of the model.
- [Linked.Archi ArchiMate 3.2 Derivation Rules](https://meta.linked.archi/archimate3/derivation): SHACL rules (sh:SPARQLRule) implementing the ArchiMate 3.2 derivation rules of Appendix B: DR1–DR8, whose derived relationships are valid in any model, and PDR1–PDR12, whose derived relationships 
- [Linked.Archi ArchiMate 3.2 Element & Metamodel Shapes](https://meta.linked.archi/archimate3/element-shapes): SHACL shapes for validating ArchiMate 3.2 element instances and the metamodel patterns the relationship tables cannot express: element names, self-loops and cycles of composition and aggregation, a pa
- [Linked.Archi ArchiMate 3.2 Metamodel Definition](https://meta.linked.archi/archimate3/metamodel): Metamodel manifest for ArchiMate 3.2.
- [Linked.Archi ArchiMate 3.2 Visual Notation Set](https://meta.linked.archi/archimate3/notation): Visual notation descriptors for ArchiMate 3.2 elements and relationships.
- [Linked.Archi ArchiMate 3.0 Ontology](https://meta.linked.archi/archimate3/onto/3.0): OWL ontology defining ArchiMate 3.0 element types and relationships for Linked.Archi.
- [Linked.Archi ArchiMate 3.1 Ontology](https://meta.linked.archi/archimate3/onto/3.1): Linked.Archi ArchiMate 3.1 Ontology.
- [Linked.Archi ArchiMate 3.2 Ontology](https://meta.linked.archi/archimate3/onto): Linked.Archi ArchiMate ontology aligned to the ArchiMate 3.2 specification, modernized to conform to Linked.Archi core ontology conventions, the qualified relationship pattern, and RDF 1.2.
- [Linked.Archi ArchiMate 3.2 Presentation Contexts](https://meta.linked.archi/archimate3/presentation-contexts): Stakeholder-specific presentation themes for ArchiMate views.
- [Linked.Archi Architecture Principle Shapes](https://meta.linked.archi/archimate3/principle-shapes): SHACL shapes encoding common enterprise architecture principles and best practices as executable constraints.
- [Linked.Archi ArchiMate 3.2 Questions](https://meta.linked.archi/archimate3/questions): Questions ArchiMate 3.2 stakeholders ask of a model — impact of change, application dependencies, data access, responsibilities, realisation and traceability — and the findings that show where a c
- [Linked.Archi ArchiMate 3.2 Reference Data](https://meta.linked.archi/archimate3/reference-data): Controlled vocabularies and reference data for ArchiMate 3.2 models, used for classifying and annotating architecture elements.
- [Linked.Archi ArchiMate 3.2 Reference Models](https://meta.linked.archi/archimate3/reference-models): Catalog of reference architectures, patterns, and building blocks that can be used as starting points for ArchiMate models.
- [Linked.Archi ArchiMate 3.2 Relationship Tables](https://meta.linked.archi/archimate3/relationship-tables): The relationship tables of ArchiMate 3.2 (Appendix B.5) as lookups: for each element type, the types each relationship may go to — directly, or as the result of a derivation — as annotations on th

- [Linked.Archi Architecture Processes Extension](https://meta.linked.archi/arch-processes): Extension ontology describing architecture governance processes, activities, tasks, and their inputs and outputs.

- [Linked.Archi Architecture Processes Taxonomy](https://meta.linked.archi/arch-processes/tax): Classification of the Architecture Processes element types — the structure of a process, its deliverables and its roles — and of the relationship types that draw its links.

- [Linked.Archi ATAM SHACL Shapes](https://meta.linked.archi/atam/shapes): SHACL shapes for validating ATAM (Architecture Tradeoff Analysis Method) evaluation records — utility trees, risks, non-risks, sensitivity points and tradeoff points.
- [Linked.Archi ATAM Taxonomy](https://meta.linked.archi/atam/tax): Classification of the ATAM element types — the evaluation, the utility tree it builds and the findings it produces — and of the relationship types that draw its links.

- [Linked.Archi Backstage Deliverable Templates](https://meta.linked.archi/backstage/deliverable-templates): Catalogue of deliverable templates for generating architecture documents from Backstage catalog models — a service catalog, a system architecture document, and an organization structure document.

- [Linked.Archi Backstage Presentation Contexts](https://meta.linked.archi/backstage/presentation-contexts): Stakeholder-specific presentation contexts for Backstage catalog views.

- [Linked.Archi Backstage Viewpoints](https://meta.linked.archi/backstage/viewpoints): Backstage Software Catalog viewpoints for visualizing service ownership, system dependencies, API landscapes, domain organization, organizational structure, and lifecycle portfolio.
- [Linked.Archi Basic Metamodel Definition](https://meta.linked.archi/basic/metamodel): Metamodel manifest for Basic, a minimal Linked.Archi modelling language.
- [Linked.Archi Basic Visual Notation Set (rectangle)](https://meta.linked.archi/basic/notation): Default visual notation set of the Linked.Archi Basic asset set, named by the manifest https://meta.linked.archi/basic/metamodel#Basic with arch:notationSet.
- [Linked.Archi Basic Visual Notation Set (bubble)](https://meta.linked.archi/basic/notation-bubble): Alternative, circle-based (bubble) visual notation set of the Linked.Archi Basic asset set.

- [Linked.Archi Business Model Canvas Metamodel Definition](https://meta.linked.archi/bmc/metamodel): Metamodel manifest for the Business Model Canvas.

- [Linked.Archi BPMN Cross-Language Mappings](https://meta.linked.archi/bpmn/crossmappings): Cross-language SKOS mappings between BPMN 2.0.2 concepts and ArchiMate modeling language concepts, for both ArchiMate 3.2 and ArchiMate 4.0.
- [Linked.Archi DC Ontology (OMG DD/DC)](https://meta.linked.archi/bpmn/dc): OWL mapping of the OMG DD Diagram Common (DC) datatypes.

- [Linked.Archi BPMN Deliverable Templates](https://meta.linked.archi/bpmn/deliverable-templates): Deliverable template definitions for generating process documentation from BPMN models.

- [Linked.Archi DI SHACL Shapes (OMG DD/DI)](https://meta.linked.archi/bpmn/di-core-shapes): SHACL shapes validating OMG Diagram Interchange (DI) abstract classes — Diagram, DiagramElement, Shape, Edge, Label, and Style.
- [Linked.Archi BPMN DI 2.0.2 Ontology](https://meta.linked.archi/bpmn/di): OWL mapping of the OMG BPMN 2.0.2 Diagram Interchange (BPMNDI) package.

- [Linked.Archi BPMN Lite SHACL Shapes](https://meta.linked.archi/bpmn-lite/shapes): SHACL validation shapes for the BPMN Lite ontology.
- [Linked.Archi BPMN Lite Taxonomy](https://meta.linked.archi/bpmn-lite/tax): Classification of BPMN Lite elements by BPMN category — flow objects, connecting objects, swim lanes, and data.

- [Linked.Archi Core Deliverable Templates](https://meta.linked.archi/core-deliverable-templates): Framework-agnostic deliverable templates of common architecture documents, produced from a model in any language: each section answers the concerns it names by asking the core model questions.
- [Core Linked.Archi Ontology](https://meta.linked.archi/core): Core Linked.Archi Ontology for Enterprise and IT Architecture modeling.
- [Linked.Archi Core Questions](https://meta.linked.archi/core-questions): The questions any Linked.Archi model answers, whatever its modelling language: what it contains, what an element is related to, which views show what, and how sound the description is.
- [Linked.Archi Core SHACL Shapes](https://meta.linked.archi/core-shapes): Base SHACL shapes for the Linked.Archi core ontology.
- [Linked.Archi Core Viewpoints](https://meta.linked.archi/core-viewpoints): Framework-agnostic architecture viewpoints derived from ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010 and common architecture practice.

## Namespace Convention

All ontologies use `https://meta.linked.archi/` as the base namespace.
Append `#` for hash-namespace ontologies (e.g., `https://meta.linked.archi/core#`).

## How to Use

1. Dereference any namespace URI with an RDF-aware client (e.g., `curl -H "Accept: text/turtle" https://meta.linked.archi/core`)
2. Browse the [Ontology Catalog](https://meta.linked.archi/) for interactive HTML documentation
3. Read the [Quick Start Guide](https://meta.linked.archi/docs/guide/quick-start/) for authoring models
4. Use SHACL shapes for validation (every metamodel ships with constraint shapes)
